---
title: "Publication List"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!requireNamespace("RefManageR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("RefManageR")
}
library(RefManageR)

bib <- ReadBib("scopus.bib", check = FALSE)
bib_df <- as.data.frame(bib)

# Sort descending by year
bib_df <- bib_df[order(as.numeric(bib_df$year), decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Loop and print by year
current_year <- ""
for (i in seq_len(nrow(bib_df))) {
  row <- bib_df[i, ]
  if (!identical(row$year, current_year)) {
    current_year <- row$year
    cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", current_year))
  }

  doi_link <- ifelse(
    !is.null(row$doi) && !is.na(row$doi),
    sprintf(" [DOI: %s](https://doi.org/%s)", row$doi, row$doi),
    ""
  )

  cat(sprintf(
    "* **%s** (%s). %s. *%s*%s\n",
    row$author,
    row$year,
    row$title,
    ifelse(!is.na(row$journal), row$journal, ""),
    doi_link
  ))
}
```
